# Undercurrent: every setting (knob)

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen-knobs-doc.mjs from the knob registry. Do not edit by hand: run `node tools/gen-knobs-doc.mjs`. -->

681 settings in 30 groups. Change any of them in **All settings** (`/uc-knobs`), with `/uc-set <key> <value> [chat=true]`, or through a profile. Values are stored in `extensionSettings.undercurrent.knobs` (only the ones you changed); per-chat overrides live in `chatMetadata.undercurrent.knob_overrides`. Chat-scope goal settings live in the chat's goals block.

Columns: **type** (`bool`, `int`, `number`, `select`, `text`, `textarea`, `list`, `json`), **default**, **range / options**, **scope** (`chat` = per chat by default), and what it does. *adv* = shown under "Show advanced".

## General

Master switches, mode and director cadence.

| key | type | default | range / options | scope | effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `core.enabled` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Enabled.** Master switch. Off clears the note immediately and stops every hidden pass. |
| `core.mode` | select | `separate` | `separate` `inreply` | global | **Mode.** Separate: a hidden director pass before each reply and a scribe pass after it. In-reply: the main model appends a hidden <!--uc {…} --> record that is parsed and stripped (one call fewer per turn). |
| `core.cadence` | select | `every` | `every` `2` `3` `stall` | global | **Director cadence.** How often the director plans. Between plans the last plan's minds/avoid lines are reused without its beat. |
| `core.pre_reply` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Run the director before the reply.** On: the director sees your latest message (adds latency up to the timeout). Off: it plans the next turn in the background right after each reply. |
| `core.paused` | bool | `false` |  | global | **Paused (all chats).** Same as /uc-pause: no hidden passes and no note until resumed. |
| `core.chat_paused` | bool | `false` |  | chat | **Paused in this chat.** Pause Undercurrent for the current chat only (/uc-pause chat=true). |
| `core.reroll_reuse_plan` | bool *adv* | `true` |  | global | **Swipes reuse the turn's plan.** Swipes and regenerations reuse the plan made for the same player message instead of running the director again. |
| `core.plan_cache_size` | int *adv* | `20` | 1–500 | global | **Plan cache size.** How many recent per-message plans are kept in memory for swipes. |
| `core.toast_on_failure` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Warn when hidden passes keep failing.** Show a toast after several failures in a row. |
| `core.failure_toast_after` | int *adv* | `3` | 1–50 | global | **Failures before warning.** Consecutive hidden-pass failures before the warning toast. |
| `core.failure_toast_cooldown_min` | number *adv* | `5` | 0–240 | global | **Warning cooldown (minutes).** Minimum time between two failure toasts. |
| `core.debug` | bool | `false` |  | global | **Debug logging.** Log plans, ops, rejections and the final note to the browser console with the [Undercurrent] prefix. |

## Display

Undercurrent never prints into the chat. At most, an optional closed "Behind the scenes" panel under each reply (screen only).

| key | type | default | range / options | scope | effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `display.peek` | select | `off` | `off` `collapsed` | global | **"Behind the scenes" peek.** Collapsed: a closed panel under each reply shows that turn's direction, characters, goals, fired rules and events, engine lines and corrections. Screen only: never in the message text, the chat file or anything sent to the model. Hidden goals stay masked. Per chat: /uc-peek on\|off. |
| `display.toasts` | select | `failures` | `failures` `all` | global | **Pop-up notices.** Undercurrent stays silent by default; "all" also announces goal tasks completed in the background. |

## Hidden passes

Connection, timeouts and token budgets for the director, scribe and seed passes.

| key | type | default | range / options | scope | effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hidden.profile_id` | text | *(empty)* |  | global | **Hidden-pass connection.** A Connection Manager profile for the director, scribe and seed passes (e.g. a cheaper model). Empty = your current connection. |
| `hidden.include_preset` | bool *adv* | `true` |  | global | **Use the profile's preset settings.** When a connection profile is set: apply its sampler preset to hidden passes. |
| `hidden.timeout_sec` | int | `45` | 5–300 | global | **Timeout (s).** Generation is never held up longer than this. On timeout the last plan is used. |
| `hidden.max_tokens` | int | `900` | 200–8000 | global | **Max tokens.** Response budget for hidden passes. |
| `hidden.director_max_tokens` | int *adv* | `0` | 0–8000 | global | **Director max tokens.** 0 = same as Max tokens. Notebook style needs a little more room than terse. |
| `hidden.scribe_max_tokens` | int *adv* | `0` | 0–8000 | global | **Scribe max tokens.** 0 = same as Max tokens. |
| `hidden.seed_max_tokens` | int *adv* | `700` | 200–8000 | global | **Seed max tokens.** Cap for the one-time intimacy seed pass (never above Max tokens). |
| `hidden.min_tokens` | int *adv* | `200` | 1–8000 | global | **Token floor.** No hidden pass asks for fewer tokens than this. |
| `hidden.wait_for_scribe_sec` | number | `12` | 0–120 | global | **Wait for the scribe (s).** Before the director runs, wait up to this long for a still-running scribe pass so the director sees the latest facts. 0 = never wait. |
| `hidden.wait_for_scribe_share` | number *adv* | `0.3` | 0–1 | global | **Scribe wait share of the timeout.** The wait is also capped at this share of the remaining timeout. |
| `hidden.seed_budget_share` | number *adv* | `0.4` | 0–1 | global | **Seed share of the timeout.** The first-turn seed pass may use at most this share of the remaining timeout. |
| `hidden.seed_budget_max_sec` | number *adv* | `20` | 0–300 | global | **Seed time cap (s).** Absolute cap for the seed pass inside the interceptor. |
| `hidden.seed_min_budget_sec` | number *adv* | `2` | 0–60 | global | **Seed minimum time (s).** Skip seeding this turn when less time than this is left. |
| `hidden.director_min_budget_sec` | number *adv* | `3` | 0–60 | global | **Director minimum time (s).** Skip the director this turn when less time than this is left. |

## Note style

How the injected note reads: the narrator persona's backstage notebook, or terse labeled lines.

| key | type | default | range / options | scope | effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `note.style` | select | `notebook` | `notebook` `terse` | global | **Note style.** Notebook: the director writes a first-person backstage scribble in the narrator persona's voice, matching the preset's register; facts, clock, intimacy and tic lines follow. Falls back to terse when the notebook is missing. Terse: v1.0 labeled lines. |
| `note.notebook_min_words` | int | `60` | 10–400 | global | **Notebook length: min words.** Asked of the director. |
| `note.notebook_max_words` | int | `140` | 20–600 | global | **Notebook length: max words.** Asked of the director. The whole note is still capped by Injection → Word cap. |
| `note.min_valid_words` | int *adv* | `12` | 1–200 | global | **Shortest usable notebook (words).** A notebook shorter than this counts as missing (terse lines are used instead). |
| `note.notebook_priority` | int *adv* | `90` | 0–200 | global | **Notebook priority.** Priority of the notebook against the word cap (higher = kept longer). |
| `note.follow` | list | `["clock","intimacy","facts","tics","goals","sparks","scene_intimacy","reply_shape","critic","drama"]` | `clock` `present` `beat` `pacing` `event` `author` `stall` `moves` `minds` `intimacy` `facts` `offscreen` `avoid` `tics` `goals` `sparks` `scene_intimacy` `desire` `psyche` `reply_shape` `critic` `drama` | global | **Lines that follow the notebook.** Which terse sections are still added after the notebook (the notebook itself covers beat, minds, event, off-screen and avoid). |
| `note.label_now` | text *adv* | `Where & when` |  | global | **Notebook label: clock.** Casual prefix for the clock line in notebook style. |
| `note.label_here` | text *adv* | `In the room` |  | global | **Notebook label: who is here.**  |
| `note.label_facts` | text *adv* | `Stuff that's true, don't screw it up` |  | global | **Notebook label: facts.**  |
| `note.label_prose` | text *adv* | `Quit doing this` |  | global | **Notebook label: tic corrections.**  |
| `note.label_intimacy` | text *adv* | `Heat file` |  | global | **Notebook label: intimacy.**  |

## Director

What the director sees, how big its plan may be, and its taste.

| key | type | default | range / options | scope | effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `director.prompt_style` | select | `voiced` | `voiced` `plain` | global | **Director prompt voice.** Voiced writes the director's instructions in the active narrator persona's own loud backstage voice (same rules, still strict JSON). The invisible author always gets the plain prompt. |
| `director.extra_instructions` | textarea | *(empty)* |  | global | **Extra director instructions.** Appended to the director prompt as "Additional instructions from the author". Keep them about the world, never about {{user}}'s choices. |
| `director.pacing_bias` | select | `auto` | `auto` `linger` `advance` `cut` | global | **Preferred pacing.** Tells the director which pacing to prefer unless the scene needs another. |
| `director.include_taste` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Use persona / tone / genre taste.** Flavor the director with the preset's narrator persona, tone, genre lens and favored beat types. |
| `director.include_pronoun` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Pass the {{user}} pronoun rule.** From the preset's pronoun toggle. |
| `director.include_cast` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Show the director the card.** The <cast> block (character card + persona). |
| `director.include_continuity` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Show the director the state summary.** The <continuity> block (characters, facts, threads, arcs). |
| `director.include_recent` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Show the director recent messages.** The <recent> transcript (length under Context budgets). |
| `director.include_used_beats` | bool | `true` |  | global | **List recently used beats.** So the director does not repeat itself. |
| `director.include_tic_notes` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Pass tic-guard findings.** The writer's recent tics, so the plan steers away from them. |
| `director.include_last_beat` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Show the previous beat.**  |
| `director.include_goals` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Show the director the story goals.** The <goals> block from Goals & Tasks (advance them through the world, never through {{user}}). |

| `director.rule_hint_chars` | int *adv* | `200` | 20–1000 | global | **Rule hint length (chars).**  |
| `director.max_social` | int | `6` | 0–30 | global | **Max characters in "social".**  |
| `director.max_drivers` | int | `2` | 0–10 | global | **Max drivers per plan.** Planted agendas / objects / people / deadlines. |
| `director.max_npc_moves` | int | `3` | 0–12 | global | **Max NPC moves per plan.**  |
| `director.max_offscreen` | int | `3` | 0–12 | global | **Max off-screen threads per plan.**  |
| `director.max_avoid` | int | `5` | 0–20 | global | **Max avoid items per plan.**  |
| `director.used_beats_shown` | int | `6` | 0–30 | global | **Used beats shown.** How many recent beats the director is told not to repeat (how many are remembered: Memory limits → Used beats). |
| `director.tic_notes_shown` | int | `3` | 0–10 | global | **Tic notes shown.**  |

## Events

Random pulse / twist / curiosity dice: chances, cooldowns and suppression.

| key | type | default | range / options | scope | effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `events.drama` | number | `1` | 0–5 | global | **Drama.** 0 = no random events · 1 = default · 2 = twice as eventful. Clamped to the drama ceiling. |
| `events.drama_max` | number *adv* | `2` | 0.5–5 | global | **Drama ceiling.** Highest effective drama value. |
| `events.enable_pulse` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Pulse events.** Ambient life in the scene. |
| `events.enable_twist` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Twist events.** Complications and reversals. |
| `events.enable_curiosity` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Curiosity events.** Mysteries and questions planted. |
| `events.base_pulse` | number | `0.12` | 0–1 | global | **Pulse base chance.** Per-turn chance at drama 1, before lens biases. |
| `events.base_twist` | number | `0.1` | 0–1 | global | **Twist base chance.** Per-turn chance at drama 1, before lens biases. |
| `events.base_curiosity` | number | `0.08` | 0–1 | global | **Curiosity base chance.** Per-turn chance at drama 1, before lens biases. |
| `events.cooldown_pulse` | int | `3` | 0–100 | global | **Pulse cooldown (turns).**  |
| `events.cooldown_twist` | int | `6` | 0–100 | global | **Twist cooldown (turns).**  |
| `events.cooldown_curiosity` | int | `5` | 0–100 | global | **Curiosity cooldown (turns).**  |
| `events.stall_boost_pulse` | number *adv* | `1.5` | 0–10 | global | **Pulse stall boost.** Chance multiplier while the story is stalled. |
| `events.stall_boost_twist` | number *adv* | `1.5` | 0–10 | global | **Twist stall boost.** Chance multiplier while the story is stalled. |
| `events.stall_boost_curiosity` | number *adv* | `1` | 0–10 | global | **Curiosity stall boost.** Chance multiplier while the story is stalled. |
| `events.max_chance` | number | `0.6` | 0–1 | global | **Max chance per kind.** Ceiling after drama and biases. |
| `events.min_gap` | int | `2` | 0–50 | global | **Minimum turns between events.**  |
| `events.one_per_turn` | bool | `true` |  | global | **At most one event per turn.** Off: every kind that rolls under its chance fires together. |
| `events.use_lens_bias` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Apply persona / tone / genre event biases.**  |
| `events.suppressed_modes` | list | `["intimate","grief","argument"]` | `conversation` `action` `intimate` `romantic` `flirt` `grief` `argument` `tension` `quiet` `travel` `comedy` | global | **No events in these scenes.** Scene modes (recorded by the scribe) in which no random event fires. |
| `events.content_chars` | int *adv* | `240` | 20–2000 | global | **Stored event length (chars).**  |

## Desire pulse

Occasional, character-true impulses drawn from intimacy profiles and their evidence. Limits and negative evidence always win.

| key | type | default | range / options | scope | effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `desire.enabled` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Desire pulse.** Every few turns, one present character gets one concrete impulse drawn from their own intimacy profile. Also needs the intimacy engine on. |
| `desire.cadence_turns` | int | `3` | 1–50 | global | **Pulse every N turns.** Minimum turns between pulses when no attraction is live. |
| `desire.live_bypass` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Pulse sooner while attraction is live.** Live, unacted attraction (or a fresh intimate thread) lets a pulse come after the shorter gap below. |
| `desire.live_min_gap` | int | `1` | 0–20 | global | **Gap while attraction is live (turns).**  |
| `desire.pulse_chance` | number | `100` | 0–100 | global | **Chance a due pulse fires (%).** 100 = always when due. |
| `desire.suppressed_modes` | list | `["grief","argument"]` |  | global | **Quiet in scene modes.** No impulses in these scene modes. |

| `desire.label_some` | text | `shown a few times` |  | global | **Label: some evidence.**  |
| `desire.label_established` | text | `well established` |  | global | **Label: well established.**  |
| `desire.label_recent` | text | `, recently` |  | global | **Suffix: recent evidence.**  |

## Psyche

Per-character appraisal of recorded events: emotion, decay, lasting memories, insight moments and defenses under stress.

| key | type | default | range / options | scope | effect |

| `psyche.enabled` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Psyche engine.** Appraise recorded events per character into emotions, lasting memories, insights and defenses. |

First match wins. |
| `psyche.negative_emotions` | list | `["anger","shame","regret","fear","sadness","frustration","contempt"]` |  | global | **Emotions that count as stress.**  |
| `psyche.stakes` | json *adv* | `{"low":0.3,"medium":0.55,"high":0.85}` |  | global | **Intensity by stakes.** Base intensity (0..1) for the event's stakes. |

| `psyche.surprise_factor` | number | `1.2` | 0.5–3 | global | **Intensity factor when it was unexpected.**  |
| `psyche.uncertain_factor` | number | `0.85` | 0.1–2 | global | **Intensity factor when it is uncertain.**  |
| `psyche.half_life` | number | `3` | 0.5–100 | global | **Emotion half-life (turns).** An emotion's intensity halves every this many turns. |
| `psyche.floor` | number | `0.08` | 0–1 | global | **Forget feelings below.**  |
| `psyche.show_floor` | number | `0.18` | 0–1 | global | **Mention feelings above.**  |
| `psyche.feelings_shown` | int | `2` | 0–6 | global | **Feelings named per character.**  |
| `psyche.max_emotions` | int | `12` | 1–60 | global | **Emotions kept per character.**  |
| `psyche.intensity_words` | json *adv* | `[[0.35,"a trace of"],[0.65,"clear"],[1,"consuming"]]` |  | global | **Intensity words.** Ascending [upper bound, word] pairs used instead of numbers. |
| `psyche.memory_threshold` | number | `0.7` | 0–1 | global | **Significance gate: intensity that becomes a lasting memory.** Only events at least this intense are remembered as grudges, bonds, wounds, wariness or milestones. |

| `psyche.insight_weight` | number | `1.6` | 0.1–20 | global | **Insight: accumulated intensity needed.** Repeated evidence on one theme (same feeling, same cause) adds up until this. |
| `psyche.insight_min_events` | int | `2` | 1–20 | global | **Insight: events needed.**  |
| `psyche.insight_cooldown` | int | `6` | 0–100 | global | **Insight cooldown per character (turns).**  |
| `psyche.insight_show_turns` | int | `2` | 1–20 | global | **An insight stays in the note for (turns).**  |

## Reply shape

Reply length matched to the player's turn, repeat vetoes on openings/endings/beat types, and a spark when replies flatten.

| key | type | default | range / options | scope | effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reply_shape.enabled` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Reply shape.** Length hint from the player's turn, repeat vetoes and a spark when replies flatten. |
| `reply_shape.length_enabled` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Length hint.**  |
| `reply_shape.short_max_words` | int | `12` | 1–200 | global | **Player turn counts as short up to (words).** Spoken/acted words only; private *thoughts* are not counted. |
| `reply_shape.long_min_words` | int | `80` | 2–2000 | global | **Player turn counts as long from (words).**  |
| `reply_shape.short_min` | int | `180` | 20–2000 | global | **Short turn: reply words min.**  |
| `reply_shape.short_max` | int | `320` | 20–3000 | global | **Short turn: reply words max.**  |
| `reply_shape.medium_min` | int | `300` | 20–2000 | global | **Medium turn: reply words min.**  |
| `reply_shape.medium_max` | int | `480` | 20–3000 | global | **Medium turn: reply words max.**  |
| `reply_shape.long_min` | int | `420` | 20–3000 | global | **Long turn: reply words min.**  |
| `reply_shape.long_max` | int | `600` | 20–4000 | global | **Long turn: reply words max.**  |
| `reply_shape.short_template` | textarea | *(built-in text, 115 chars)* |  | global | **Short turn line.** Placeholders: {{uc_min}}, {{uc_max}}.Placeholders: `{{uc_min}}`, `{{uc_max}}`, `{{uc_kind}}`, `{{uc_callback}}`. |
| `reply_shape.medium_template` | textarea | `Length: {{uc_min}}–{{uc_max}} words.` |  | global | **Medium turn line.** Placeholders: `{{uc_min}}`, `{{uc_max}}`, `{{uc_kind}}`, `{{uc_callback}}`. |
| `reply_shape.long_template` | textarea | *(built-in text, 110 chars)* |  | global | **Long turn line.** Placeholders: `{{uc_min}}`, `{{uc_max}}`, `{{uc_kind}}`, `{{uc_callback}}`. |
| `reply_shape.dialogue_heavy_ratio` | number | `0.6` | 0–1 | global | **Player turn counts as dialogue-heavy from (share of words in quotes).**  |
| `reply_shape.dialogue_heavy_text` | text | `The player mostly spoke: answer in speech first.` |  | global | **Dialogue-heavy line.** Empty = none. |
| `reply_shape.window` | int | `3` | 1–12 | global | **Veto window (replies).** Recent replies compared for repeats. |
| `reply_shape.veto_count` | int | `2` | 1–12 | global | **Veto after (uses within the window).**  |
| `reply_shape.beat_lexicon` | json *adv* | `{"touch":["touches","hand","hands","hug","kiss","kisses","holds","grabs","strokes","leans into"],"confession":["admits","confess","confesses","truth is","never told","i lied","i'm sorry","i am sorry"],"arrival":["door opens","walks in","arrives","knock","knocks","appears","shows up"],"departure":["leaves","walks out","storms off","turns to go","gone"],"conflict":["shouts","snaps","accuses","slams","argue","argues","glares","threat","threatens"],"humor":["laughs","grins","jokes","snorts","teases","smirk","smirks"],"revelation":["realizes","discovers","turns out","reveals","finds out","secret"],"gift":["gives","hands over","offers","present","gift"],"memory":["remembers","used to","back then","years ago","once"]}` |  | global | **Beat-type lexicon.** Map of beat type to words that show it (code-side, edit for other languages). |
| `reply_shape.beat_min_hits` | int | `1` | 1–10 | global | **Words needed to count a beat type.**  |
| `reply_shape.vetoes_shown` | int | `3` | 0–10 | global | **Vetoes per turn.**  |
| `reply_shape.veto_open_template` | textarea | `Do not open with {{uc_kind}} again.` |  | global | **Veto: opening.** Placeholders: `{{uc_min}}`, `{{uc_max}}`, `{{uc_kind}}`, `{{uc_callback}}`. |
| `reply_shape.veto_close_template` | textarea | `Do not end on {{uc_kind}} again.` |  | global | **Veto: ending.** Placeholders: `{{uc_min}}`, `{{uc_max}}`, `{{uc_kind}}`, `{{uc_callback}}`. |
| `reply_shape.veto_shape_template` | textarea | *(built-in text, 66 chars)* |  | global | **Veto: paragraph shape.** Placeholders: `{{uc_min}}`, `{{uc_max}}`, `{{uc_kind}}`, `{{uc_callback}}`. |
| `reply_shape.veto_beat_template` | textarea | *(built-in text, 67 chars)* |  | global | **Veto: beat type.** Placeholders: `{{uc_min}}`, `{{uc_max}}`, `{{uc_kind}}`, `{{uc_callback}}`. |
| `reply_shape.class_names` | json *adv* | `{"dialogue":"dialogue","thought":"a private thought","narration":"narration","question":"a question","action":"an action"}` |  | global | **Names for openings / endings.**  |

| `reply_shape.spark_chance` | number | `100` | 0–100 | global | **Chance a due spark fires (%).**  |
| `reply_shape.spark_pool` | json *adv* | `[{"id":"want_now","channel":"character","text":"Spark: someone in the scene wants something inconvenient right now, and lets it show."},{"id":"contradiction","channel":"character","text":"Spark: let {{char}} show a side the scene has not seen yet, one that is still true to the card."},{"id":"bad_idea","channel":"character","text":"Spark: a tempting bad idea, proposed or acted on by someone other than {{user}}."},{"id":"comic","channel":"humor","text":"Spark: something small goes comically wrong, or someone says the wrong thing at the right time."},{"id":"outside","channel":"world","text":"Spark: the world outside the scene intrudes with a concrete source: a message, a neighbor, weather, a deadline."},{"id":"object","channel":"world","text":"Spark: an object in the room becomes important."},{"id":"sense","channel":"sensory","text":"Spark: lead with a sense the last replies ignored."},{"id":"stakes","channel":"plot","text":"Spark: a cost appears; something that was safe is not anymore."},{"id":"callback","channel":"callback","text":"Spark: an older thread comes back changed: {{uc_callback}}."},{"id":"contrast","channel":"chemistry","text":"Spark: tension through contrast; two people want different things from the same moment."}]` |  | global | **Spark pool.** {id, channel, text}. The same channel is not used twice in a row. Callback sparks need {{uc_callback}}. |
| `reply_shape.callback_min_age` | int | `6` | 1–500 | global | **Callback maturity: facts at least this old (turns).** Fresher material is continuity, not a callback. |
| `reply_shape.suppressed_modes` | list | `["intimate","grief"]` |  | global | **No sparks in scene modes.**  |
| `reply_shape.history` | int | `8` | 2–40 | global | **Reply fingerprints kept.**  |
| `reply_shape.pri_length` | int | `66` | 0–100 | global | **Note priority: length.**  |
| `reply_shape.pri_veto` | int | `54` | 0–100 | global | **Note priority: vetoes.**  |

## Tic guard

Repetition, slop, echo, mind-read, opening and stall detection, and the correction wording.

| key | type | default | range / options | scope | effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ticguard.enabled` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Tic guard.** Code-only repetition, slop, echo, mind-read, opening and stall detection with short, escalating corrections. |
| `ticguard.detect_repeats` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Detect repeated phrases.**  |
| `ticguard.detect_slop` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Detect slop phrases.**  |
| `ticguard.detect_echo` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Detect echoing your words.**  |
| `ticguard.detect_mindread` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Detect reactions to your *private thoughts*.**  |
| `ticguard.detect_opening` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Detect repeated openings.**  |
| `ticguard.detect_samey` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Detect near-identical replies.**  |
| `ticguard.slop_profile` | select | `auto` | `auto` `none` `common` `deepseek-v4` `deepseek-r1` `glm-5` `kimi-k2` `mimo-2.5` `mimo-2.6-pro` | global | **Slop list.** Which model's slop list to use (the common list is always included unless None). |
| `ticguard.custom_bans` | list | `[]` |  | global | **Your banned phrases.** One per line; merged with the model slop list. Wrap in /slashes/ for a regular expression. |
| `ticguard.custom_slop` | json *adv* | `[]` |  | global | **Custom slop entries (JSON).** Advanced: [{"pattern":"…","kind":"phrase\|regex","note":"…","min":1}] — min > 1 needs that many hits across recent replies. |
| `ticguard.stall_turns` | int | `4` | 2–50 | global | **Stall after (turns).** Turns without a new fact, place, time or character that count as a stall. |
| `ticguard.window` | int | `4` | 1–20 | global | **Replies compared.** How many previous replies repetition is checked against. |
| `ticguard.ngram_min` | int | `3` | 2–10 | global | **Shortest repeated phrase (words).**  |
| `ticguard.ngram_max` | int | `6` | 2–12 | global | **Longest repeated phrase (words).**  |
| `ticguard.repeat_threshold` | int | `1` | 1–10 | global | **Repeated phrases before flagging.**  |
| `ticguard.max_repeats` | int *adv* | `5` | 1–20 | global | **Repeated phrases collected.**  |
| `ticguard.echo_min_words` | int | `4` | 2–20 | global | **Echo threshold (words).** A span of your spoken words this long repeated in the reply counts as an echo. |
| `ticguard.echo_max_words` | int *adv* | `10` | 2–40 | global | **Longest echo checked (words).**  |
| `ticguard.mindread_min_words` | int | `3` | 2–10 | global | **Mind-read threshold (words).**  |
| `ticguard.opening_window` | int | `3` | 1–10 | global | **Opening-repeat window (replies).**  |
| `ticguard.opening_words` | int *adv* | `3` | 1–10 | global | **Opening words compared.**  |
| `ticguard.opening_class_run` | int *adv* | `2` | 0–10 | global | **Same opening type in a row.** Flag when this many recent replies open the same way (dialogue / thought). 0 = off. |
| `ticguard.samey_threshold` | number | `0.55` | 0–1 | global | **Near-identical threshold.** Content-word overlap with the previous reply that counts as near-identical. |
| `ticguard.slop_recent` | int *adv* | `3` | 0–10 | global | **Replies counted for weak slop.**  |
| `ticguard.decay` | number *adv* | `0.5` | 0–5 | global | **Tic memory decay per clean reply.**  |
| `ticguard.counts_max` | int *adv* | `40` | 1–500 | global | **Tics remembered.**  |
| `ticguard.max_level` | int | `3` | 1–3 | global | **Highest escalation level.** 1 = nudge, 2 = firm, 3 = hard ban. |

## Critic

Free code-side rule checks every turn, plus an optional hidden critic pass that returns up to 3 corrections.

| key | type | default | range / options | scope | effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `critic.enabled` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Code-side rule checks.** Free heuristics on every reply; violations become corrections for the next reply. |
| `critic.check_user_script` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Check: scripting {{user}}.**  |
| `critic.check_user_interior` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Check: narrating {{user}}'s inner life.**  |
| `critic.check_mindread` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Check: reacting to private thoughts.** Off when the tic guard already reports mind-reading. |
| `critic.check_tense` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Check: narration tense.**  |
| `critic.check_pov` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Check: narration point of view.**  |
| `critic.check_thoughts` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Check: *private thoughts* present.**  |
| `critic.check_dialogue` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Check: dialogue present.**  |
| `critic.check_question_end` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Check: ending on a question / menu for the player.**  |
| `critic.defer_to_ticguard` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Leave mind-reading, slop and repetition to the tic guard.** Avoids duplicate corrections; the critic still checks everything else. |

## Goals

| key | type | default | range / options | scope | effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `goals.enabled` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Goals & Tasks.** Master switch for goals: injection, director brief, checks and task generation. |

## Goals · Checks

| key | type | default | range / options | scope | effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `goals.check_every` | number | `3` | 0–50 | chat | **Check for completed tasks every N replies.** One batched hidden request checks every active goal's current task. 0 = only when you press Check now. |
| `goals.swipes_count` | bool | `false` |  | chat | **Swipes and regenerations count toward the check cadence.** Off: only new replies to a new player message count. |
| `goals.uncounted_types` | list | `["quiet","impersonate","continue","append","appendFinal","first_message","command","extension"]` |  | global | **Reply types that never count.** SillyTavern MESSAGE_RECEIVED types skipped by the cadence counter, one per line. |
| `goals.check_transcript_messages` | number | `8` | 1–40 | global | **Messages the check reads.** How many recent chat messages the completion check sees. |
| `goals.check_max_tokens` | number | `600` | 100–4000 | global | **Check response tokens.** Max tokens for the check reply. |
| `goals.check_require_evidence` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Require a verbatim quote to auto-complete.** On: a task completes only when the checker quotes the recent messages word for word. Strongly recommended. |
| `goals.evidence_min_chars` | number | `12` | 1–200 | global | **Minimum evidence length (characters).** Shorter quotes are rejected. |
| `goals.evidence_min_words` | number | `3` | 1–30 | global | **Minimum evidence length (words).** Fewer words are rejected. Also shown to the checker as {{evidence_min_words}}. |
| `goals.evidence_fragment_min_chars` | number | `4` | 1–50 | global | **Minimum quoted fragment between ellipses.** Quotes may skip text with "…"; fragments shorter than this are ignored. |
| `goals.evidence_max_chars` | number | `300` | 40–1000 | global | **Stored evidence length (characters).** Evidence kept with a completed task. |
| `goals.reconcile_window` | number | `8` | 0–50 | global | **Re-find moved messages within N positions.** After deletions, a completion's evidence message is searched this far before the completion is undone. |
| `goals.check_system` | textarea | *(built-in text, 850 chars)* |  | global | **Check prompt (system).** Placeholders: {{evidence_min_words}}. {{user}}/{{char}} are SillyTavern macros. Must ask for {"results":[{"task_id","done","evidence"}]}. Empty = default. |
| `goals.check_user` | textarea | *(built-in text, 79 chars)* |  | global | **Check prompt (message).** Placeholders: {{tasks}} (one task line each), {{recent}} (transcript). Empty = default. |
| `goals.check_task_line` | text | `- task_id: {{task_id}} \| goal: {{goal_title}} \| task: {{task}}` |  | global | **Check task line.** Placeholders: {{task_id}}, {{goal_title}}, {{task}}, {{owner}}. |

## Chance rules

| key | type | default | range / options | scope | effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rules.enabled` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Chance rules on.** Master switch for the trigger → action rules. |
| `rules.max_note_lines` | int | `3` | 0–10 | global | **Spark lines per turn.** How many rule lines may join the hidden note each turn (inside the note's word cap). |
| `rules.max_depth` | int | `2` | 0–6 | global | **Depth injections per turn.** Separate in-chat injections for long imported blocks. |
| `rules.max_hints` | int | `2` | 0–6 | global | **Director hints per turn.** Hints handed to the hidden director (loop breakers and the like). |
| `rules.chance_multiplier` | number | `1` | 0–3 | chat | **Chance multiplier.** 0 silences chance rules, 1 = as written, 2 = twice as likely (capped at 100%). |
| `rules.default_priority` | int | `3` | 1–5 | global | **Default priority.** Priority for rules that do not set one (5 wins the budget first). |
| `rules.default_cooldown` | int | `0` | 0–50 | global | **Default cooldown (turns).** Rest turns after firing, for rules that do not set one. |
| `rules.default_sticky` | int | `0` | 0–20 | global | **Default sticky (turns).** How many extra turns an injection persists, for rules that do not set it. |
| `rules.default_depth` | int | `1` | 0–20 | global | **Default injection depth.** Chat depth for depth-placed rules without their own depth. |
| `rules.default_role` | select | `system` | `system` `user` `assistant` | global | **Default injection role.** Message role for depth-placed rules without their own role. |
| `rules.max_line_chars` | int | `240` | 60–1000 | global | **Max characters per spark line.** Longer lines are clipped. |
| `rules.max_depth_chars` | int | `4000` | 200–20000 | global | **Max characters per depth injection.** Longer imported blocks are clipped. |
| `rules.unresolved` | select | `drop` | `drop` `blank` `keep` | global | **Unresolved template tokens.** drop = skip the whole line (safest); blank = remove the token; keep = leave {{token}} as written. |
| `rules.ignore_private_thoughts` | bool | `true` |  | global | **Triggers ignore *private thoughts*.** Keyword/regex triggers read only what {{user}} says and does, never asterisk thoughts. |
| `rules.lorebary_interval_divisor` | number | `1` | 0.5–10 | global | **LoreBary messages per turn.** Imported LoreBary message counts (intervals, "after N messages") are divided by this to get player turns. 1 = one message per turn (default); 2 = count both your message and the reply. Applies to new imports. |
| `rules.default_packs` | list | `[]` |  | global | **Packs on by default.** Pack ids enabled until toggled; empty = each pack's own default. |

| `rules.safety_skip` | list *adv* | `[]` | `slow-burn mandate` `meter/tracker/footer` `tracker bar` `status readout` `numeric stat line` `print at end of reply` `stamp/footer instruction` `stage ladder` `escalation mandate` `global kink push` `instruction override` `{{user}} interior or response` `{{user}} body scripted` `{{user}} acting/feeling/speaking` `directive to write {{user}}` `{{user}} state scripted` `{{user}} modal/compulsion` `make {{user}} act` `speak/act for {{user}}` `shared climax` | global | **Disabled safety checks.** Names of built-in checks to switch off (see the list in the rules README). |

## Profiles

Loading a profile resets every setting it does not list to its default, except the sticky ones (Enabled, pauses, debug logging and the hidden-pass connection).

### Balanced

The defaults: notebook note, director every turn, moderate events.

- *(all defaults)*

### Quiet & intimate

Few interruptions, lingering pacing, scenes allowed to breathe.

- `events.drama` = `0.4`
- `events.enable_twist` = `false`
- `events.base_pulse` = `0.08`
- `events.base_curiosity` = `0.05`
- `events.cooldown_pulse` = `5`
- `events.cooldown_curiosity` = `8`
- `events.min_gap` = `4`
- `events.suppressed_modes` = `["intimate","grief","argument","quiet","tension"]`
- `director.pacing_bias` = `"linger"`
- `director.max_npc_moves` = `1`
- `director.max_drivers` = `1`
- `inject.intimacy_when` = `"auto"`
- `inject.max_npcs` = `3`

### Chaotic

High drama, frequent twists, several events can land at once.

- `events.drama` = `2`
- `events.drama_max` = `3`
- `events.base_pulse` = `0.16`
- `events.base_twist` = `0.18`
- `events.base_curiosity` = `0.12`
- `events.cooldown_pulse` = `2`
- `events.cooldown_twist` = `3`
- `events.cooldown_curiosity` = `3`
- `events.min_gap` = `1`
- `events.max_chance` = `0.75`
- `events.one_per_turn` = `false`
- `events.suppressed_modes` = `["intimate","grief"]`
- `events.stall_boost_pulse` = `2`
- `events.stall_boost_twist` = `2`
- `events.stall_boost_curiosity` = `1.5`
- `director.pacing_bias` = `"advance"`
- `director.max_drivers` = `3`
- `director.max_npc_moves` = `4`
- `ticguard.stall_turns` = `3`

### Cinematic thriller

Cuts past dead time, pressure from clocks and complications, mysteries planted early.

- `events.drama` = `1.4`
- `events.base_twist` = `0.14`
- `events.base_curiosity` = `0.12`
- `events.cooldown_twist` = `4`
- `director.pacing_bias` = `"cut"`
- `director.max_drivers` = `3`
- `director.extra_instructions` = `"Favor concrete pressure: a deadline, a threat with a source, a plan that can fail. Cut away from dead time. Every scene should end with something unresolved."`
- `ticguard.stall_turns` = `3`

### Slice of life

Ordinary days with texture: small ambient moments, rare twists, gentle pacing.

- `events.drama` = `0.8`
- `events.base_pulse` = `0.18`
- `events.base_twist` = `0.04`
- `events.base_curiosity` = `0.06`
- `events.cooldown_twist` = `10`
- `director.pacing_bias` = `"linger"`
- `director.extra_instructions` = `"Favor routines, errands, small kindnesses and small frictions over big plot. Consequences stay human-sized."`
- `ticguard.stall_turns` = `6`

### Low latency

No director wait before replies: it plans in the background after each reply and only when needed.

- `core.pre_reply` = `false`
- `core.cadence` = `"stall"`
- `hidden.wait_for_scribe_sec` = `0`
- `hidden.max_tokens` = `700`
- `context.director_messages` = `8`
- `context.scribe_messages` = `2`

## Macros

With `inject.placement` = `macros`, there is no injected note; preset blocks pull these SillyTavern macros wherever they sit. With `note` placement they return an empty string, so nothing is ever injected twice.

- `{{uc_note}}`
- `{{uc_beat}}`
- `{{uc_minds}}`
- `{{uc_intimacy}}`
- `{{uc_facts}}`
- `{{uc_scene}}`
- `{{uc_tics}}`
- `{{uc_goals}}`
- `{{uc_sparks}}`

The native port engines have their own macros (also filled only in `macros` placement):

- `{{uc_scene_intimacy}}`
- `{{uc_desire}}`
- `{{uc_psyche}}`
- `{{uc_reply_shape}}`
- `{{uc_critic}}`
- `{{uc_drama}}`
